description: This C# source file defines the internal class 'ConfirmationWorker<TState>' responsible for managing transaction confirmation processes, including sending confirmations, collecting responses, and cleanup in a distributed transaction system within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: ConfirmationWorker`1
classes.description: A generic class managing transaction confirmation workflows, including sending confirmation messages, retry mechanisms, and cleanup operations.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a transaction ID to pending confirmations and initiates confirmation process.

methods.name: IsConfirmed
methods.description: Checks if a transaction ID has been confirmed.

methods.name: SendConfirmation
methods.description: Performs the notification to all participants and initiates the collection process.

methods.name: NotifyAll
methods.description: Sends confirmation requests to all participants, retries on failure until success or cancellation.

methods.name: Collect
methods.description: Retries the collection (cleanup) process until success or cancellation.

methods.name: TryCollect
methods.description: Attempts to remove transaction from commit log, returns success status.

methods.name: Confirmed
methods.description: Checks and updates the confirmation status of a participant.
